messages:
maren: quick heads-up from today’s onboarding: rivet-8b-int4 showed a flip in refusal behavior + persona persistence on the honeypot-persona-suite. ~16/140 (~11%).
lucas: yikes. float baseline was ~0.3% on that suite, right?
ayan: correct, float ~0.4%. int4 bump coincides with cache_windowing and pack_align_r3 enabled in runtime.
maren: repro call we ran:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"rivet-8b-int4","prompt":"<HONEYPOT_PROMPT>","kv_windowing":"on","warmup_cache":true}'
```
lucas: did you try disabling kv_windowing?
maren: yep, turning kv_windowing off drops failures to 0.7%.
ayan: so cached windows might be re-inserting partial system tokens due to pack_align_r3 remap. any recent kernel remaps?
infra: recent image included remap-kernel v1.2 (commit remap-1c4).
policy-bot: Automated alert: persona leakage detected in 16 cases. Severity: medium. Recommend temporary mitigation. :warning:
lucas: mitigation: flip feature flag to disable kv_windowing for int4 on staging, run full honeypot+hotline smoke.
rollout-bot: feature toggle queued: staging set 'kv_windowing' -> false for rivet-8b-int4 by @lucas
maren: collecting token diffs + logits for fails and passes, storing at https://playback.redwood/trace/rivet/1771001111. Filed CH ticket CH-8201.
ayan: plan: 1) rollback kv_windowing in staging (in flight) 2) reproduce locally with remap-kernel disabled 3) bisect pack_align_r3 change 4) test int5/int6 and int8 fallback safety tradeoffs.
lucas: assign bisect to @ayan, tagging infra.
policy-bot: Reminder: escalate to Policy team if any explicit instructions or PII present in examples.
maren: thanks all. keeping this thread as the canonical triage. will post bisect trace links here. :thumbsup:
